name: Raw Transaction Lines
definition: Count of source transaction rows before analytical filters.
decision: Size the source and detect ingestion-volume breaks.

name: Valid Purchase Lines
definition: Count of transaction lines with CustomerID present, Quantity > 0, UnitPrice > 0 and non-cancelled invoice.

name: Net Revenue Proxy
definition: Sum of Quantity × UnitPrice over valid purchase lines.
decision: Track commercial value on the real transaction source.

name: Identified Customers
definition: Distinct CustomerID among valid purchase lines.

name: Repeat Customer Rate
definition: Share of identified customers with at least two distinct clean invoices in the observation window.
decision: Assess repeat activity and retention-proxy health.

name: CustomerID Null Rate
definition: Share of raw transaction lines where CustomerID is missing.
decision: Decide whether customer-level reporting is fit for use.

name: Cancellation Rate
definition: Share of raw transaction lines whose invoice number is marked as a cancellation.
decision: Detect transaction-state contamination before KPI publication.

name: Invalid Quantity Rate
definition: Share of raw transaction lines with Quantity <= 0.
decision: Trigger quality investigation for quantity semantics.

name: Invalid Price Rate
definition: Share of raw transaction lines with UnitPrice <= 0.

name: Customer Revenue Share
definition: Share of valid gross revenue attributable to the top 10% of identified customers by revenue.
formula: top-decile customer revenue / total identified-customer revenue
decision: Assess concentration risk before portfolio decisions.
